content.introduction: For a $7,000 TFSA investment, the sources suggest two main approaches. For those with a high tolerance for volatility and a long investment horizon, Constellation Software and goeasy are recommended. Alternatively, for a safer, tax-free interest-earning option, high-interest cash ETFs like BMO Equal Weight REITs Index ETF, iShares S&P/TSX Capped REIT Index ETF, CI Canadian REIT ETF, and Middlefield Real Estate Dividend ETF are suggested. For a hands-off approach, an all-in-one asset allocation ETF that blends global stocks and bonds is recommended. The sources do not provide a definitive answer for the best investment.

## Earning Safe, Tax-Free Interest

For those seeking a safe and tax-free way to earn interest on their TFSA contributions, high-interest cash ETFs present an appealing option, especially in the current high-interest rate environment. [...] For investors seeking a straightforward approach to managing their $7,000 TFSA contribution, an all-in-one asset allocation ETF that blends global stocks and bonds could be an ideal solution. This "set it and forget it" strategy is particularly appealing to those who prefer a hands-off investment approach.

Fidelity’s lineup of asset allocation ETFs presents an intriguing option in this space, offering a blend of traditional investment strategies with some contemporary twists. [...] In the current high-interest rate environment, many of these cash ETFs are offering net yields (after accounting for fees) of 5% or above. This makes them an attractive option for TFSA holders who wish to earn higher interest on their cash holdings without exposing themselves to significant risk.
